**v1.5.6.0 (re-release)** — first build stacked CPU/RAM and integration stats in two rows on the same card. That was wrong. This build puts them back in **one slot**: integration stats show by default, hover swaps to container CPU/RAM.

Also fixes [#15](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/15) blank card bodies from the v1.5.5.9 bento grid change.

### Fixed

- **Dual metrics layout** — Radarr/Prowlarr/etc. no longer grow a second row under CPU/RAM; integration and container metrics share one footprint again
- **Blank card bodies (#15)** — CPU/RAM and integrations render on Docker/Unraid setups that only showed the header after v1.5.5.9
- **Integration loading** — placeholder while stats fetch, without extra card height
- **Drag reorder** — handle targets the app grid only, not dashboard widgets

### Docs

- [Dashboard Widgets](https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/dashboard-widgets) — three simple examples
- Troubleshooting note for “ONLINE shows but body empty”

### Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid:

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh after upgrade (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). If you pulled the first v1.5.6.0 image, force-update again — I'm yanking that one from Docker Hub.

Still broken on Unraid? Reply on [#15](https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/issues/15) with browser + whether container metrics are enabled.
